maze.name: Maze Central Mosque
maze.note: Green dome, two minarets. Friday 1 p.m. prayers close the streets around it.

maze.name: Gidi Teaching Hospital
maze.note: The city's biggest hospital, on the Maze's edge. Where you wake up after going down. Its road floods every rain.

maze.name: Maze Police Division
maze.note: Seized okadas go to the pound behind it. Pay to get your bike back.

maze.name: Fire of Zion Ministries
maze.note: A church in a converted warehouse. Banners outside, all-night vigils on Fridays.

maze.name: Maze Community Primary School
maze.note: Public school with a sandy yard and painted walls. School-run jams at 7 a.m. and 2 p.m.

jungle.name: Jungle Police Division
jungle.note: Bike pound. Officers who know everyone.

jungle.name: White Garment Parish of Light
jungle.note: White-garment church near the canal. Barefoot worshippers, Sunday processions.

jungle.name: Model Comprehensive School
jungle.note: Big secondary school. Fights at the gate after closing.

hub.name: Hub Police Division
hub.note: Next to the interchange. Taskforce sweeps start here.

hub.name: Hub Fire Station
hub.note: Covers the interchange and the market fires.

hub.name: Victory Tabernacle
hub.note: Big auditorium church. Sunday traffic jams the Ring Road.

hub.name: Odds Palace
hub.note: Betting shop and football viewing centre. Match nights are loud.

railside.name: Railside General Hospital
railside.note: Government hospital. Long queues, short supplies.

railside.name: Railside Jumat Mosque
railside.note: Big mosque by the tracks, heart of the northern community.

railside.name: Railside Police Division
railside.note: Bike pound for the outer city.

port.name: Port Police Command
port.note: Marine police and the area command.

bazaar.name: Bazaar Police Post
bazaar.note: The market's own taskforce does more policing than this post.

capital.name: State General Hospital
capital.note: The capital's big hospital. Ambulances, crowds at the gate.

estate.name: Covenant Cathedral
estate.note: Big modern church for the estate's big men.

estate.name: Heritage International School
estate.note: Private school. Drivers wait outside in SUVs.

watertown.name: Shoreline White Garment Church
watertown.note: White-garment church on the water's edge. Baptisms in the lagoon.

watertown.name: School on Stilts
watertown.note: A school built over the water. Kids arrive by canoe.

oldshore.name: Old Shore Central Mosque
oldshore.note: The old town's main mosque. The festival week starts here.

oldshore.name: Shore General Hospital
oldshore.note: Serves the towns across the lagoon.

border.name: First Mission Church
border.note: The oldest church in Gidi, on the heritage strip.

border.name: Border Police Post
border.note: One of many agencies on the road.

border.name: Customs Command
border.note: Customs patrol base. Rice seizures stored here.

oldisland.name: Island Central Mosque
oldisland.note: Gold dome and four minarets. The biggest mosque in Gidi.

oldisland.name: Cathedral of Christ
oldisland.note: Old stone cathedral with the city's biggest organ.

oldisland.name: Island Police Division
oldisland.note: Enforces the okada ban on the island.

heights.name: Heights Private Hospital
heights.note: Where the rich get treated. Armed guards at the door.

heights.name: Lagoon International School
heights.note: Expensive international school. Convoys at 7 a.m.

heights.name: Heights Police Division
heights.note: Quick to arrive for the rich, slow for everyone else.

frontier.name: Prayer City Camp
frontier.note: A huge prayer camp on the expressway. Monthly conventions jam the road for a whole night.
